user.title: BACnet network
user.description: Configure the local BACnet/IP interface Home Assistant will use.

data.bbmd_address: BBMD address (optional, for foreign device registration)

error.cannot_connect: Unable to start the BACnet stack on this interface.

abort.already_configured: This BACnet interface is already configured.

menu_options.add_by_ip: Add a device by IP address

change_address_value.title: Change a device's IP address
change_address_value.description: New address for {device}. Entities and their history are kept: the device is identified by its instance number, not by its address. By default the device must answer at the new address with the same instance number; untick the check if it is not reachable yet.

data.verify_address: Check that the device answers at this address

add_by_ip.title: Add a device by IP
add_by_ip.description: Contact a device directly (unicast), bypassing broadcast discovery. Leave the device id empty to detect it automatically.

select_points.title: Select points
select_points.description: Choose the objects to monitor on {device}. Points are grouped by installation - expand a section, tick its points, and validate everything at once. Already-configured points are pre-selected (their sections start expanded) and keep their settings; use the search box inside a dropdown to filter.

error.not_loaded: The integration must be loaded to check the address. Untick the check to save anyway.
error.discovery_failed: Discovery failed. Check the network configuration.
error.device_not_found: No device responded at that IP address.
error.device_id_mismatch: A different device (other instance number) answered at that address.

abort.not_loaded: The integration must be loaded to discover devices.
abort.no_devices_found: No BACnet devices answered the Who-Is broadcast.
abort.no_objects_found: No objects were found on the selected device.
abort.discovery_failed: Discovery failed. Check the network configuration.
abort.device_not_found: No device responded at that IP address.

acknowledge_alarm.description: Acknowledge an alarm on a BACnet object.
